title: Flows: Generate becomes Queue - a flow frame can stack runs

summary: Fabio answered the four open decisions: result pane is latest-wins, Stop copies the PromptBox shape (own Stop button + generation.stop, per-job stop in the queue panel), no cap, Reuse restores the run that ran. The gallery-latents half split out as MPI-827.
Button copy settled: Cue / Cue xN, the PromptBox's own _runLabel, not a new word.

reason: Implementation started from handoff faf6b3dd; plan.md, checklist.md and files.json written in the same pass.

note: The Q-bug item is ticked: root cause was MpiOverlay.hide() retracting --main-overlay-z it never published.

THE Q BUG IS CLOSED, and it was never MpiSlideOver. Q opened the Cue panel on the FIRST press all along - behind the flow overlay, so nothing appeared. MpiOverlay.el.show() publishes --main-overlay-z only for mountTarget 'main-area' (MpiBaseFlow is the only one), while el.hide() retracted it UNCONDITIONALLY, its comment claiming that was safe. So any second overlay closing over a live flow - #flow-back to the Flow Library, the LoRA cogwheel's MpiModelSettings, the model picker - wiped the flow's own publication and .mpi-slide-over--queue's calc(var(--main-overlay-z, 90) + 10) fell back to 100, under the flow's 10010. Retraction now gated on the same main-area condition; all 8 MpiOverlay.mount call sites swept, only MpiBaseFlow is main-area, and MpiModal only READS the var. The handoff's surviving suspect (a stale module-level _active in MpiSlideOver) was WRONG and MpiSlideOver was not touched: _doClose is the only close path and it always emits close, confirmed live - Q#2 closes the panel normally. New spec tests/desktop/flow-queue-hotkey.spec.js drives the REAL path (real project, real gallery, real flow:open, real Flow Library over the top) and asserts onTop via elementFromPoint, because toBeVisible() cannot see a panel that is merely underneath. Red pre-fix {zIndex:100, mainOverlayZ:'', onTop:false}, green after {zIndex:10020, mainOverlayZ:10010, onTop:true}. npm test 1521/0/1 skipped, lint clean, 6/6 on the overlay-adjacent desktop specs. Card stays in doing for Fabio's round-2 pass.

SECOND APP PASS PASSED (Fabio, 2026-09-20), five steps including the #flow-back -> reopen -> Q sequence. One UI fix after it: Cue and Stop were not the same height. Measured - a text `md` MpiButton is 47px, an icon-only `md` is 50px (20px glyph), and .mpi-base-flow__run-row's align-items:stretch only reached the two block mount hosts, so Cue sat 3px short in a 50px box and read as a dented Stop. Hosts are display:flex now; both measure 50px sharing both edges. Pinned by tests/desktop/flow-run-row-heights.spec.js. NOT actioned, app-wide: the 47-vs-50 gap lives in MpiButton itself, so any text+icon pair of one size is 3px out unless its container stretches - a min-height per size would move every text button in the app and needs Fabio's call. SCOPE: MPI-827's own check (an AGENT-dispatched flow watched from the Gallery) was NOT part of the five steps and has not been run.

CI GREEN on ddd813da - 144 passed, 0 failed - so the app-wide control-height change (--control-h-sm|md|lg as a min-height per MpiButton size, every text button 3-4px taller) breaks nothing on a clean runner. The same run passed gif-cutout, gif-timing and gif-transform, which independently confirms the three LOCAL failures came from uncommitted peer edits in the shared tree (MPI-736's canvas pass) and not from anything committed. Rules updated with Fabio's permission in 6354e492: dos_and_donts.md gains the token family in the canonical list AND the Sub-Agent Briefing block, plus a new rule 4 covering the two traps the token does not solve - a non-button control has its own padding scale, and align-items:stretch reaches the ComponentFactory mount HOST rather than the component inside it. MPI-822 is code-complete and user-verified; MPI-827's own check is still unrun.
